decisions.reason: The branding colors, national positioning, and cross-location branding consistency are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Mobile-friendly behavior is already established by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE with the applicable master-site and location-site scope.
The same-message INTRODUCE already records dedicated pages for the current locations and consistent cross-location design and branding.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records the homepage location selector and current location options; general visual navigation style does not alter its routing behavior.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already captures redesign-free future-location addition and reuse with consistent design and branding.
The same-message MODIFY already captures the national brand scope and national-entertainment-site positioning; the visual design details do not otherwise change the master site's role.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records the complete homepage section list and immediate offerings visibility; visual styling does not change that composition.
The source visual-design decision does not change the Wix booking platform, booking host, or master-site booking exclusion.
Consistent visual design across locations does not alter the requirement that each operational location use a separate Wix website and account.
The visual-design update does not change the retained package catalog or pricing policies for reused location-site formats.
Cross-location visual consistency does not change the required isolation of bookings, revenue, sales, calendars, or reporting.
The source design decision does not change separate location payouts or the separate Wix account and payment setup used to provide that isolation.
